name: Toy divisibility claim (certificate-machinery test fixture)
statement: For all n in the searched domain, 7 does not divide n.
domain: non-negative integers n in a finite search interval [begin, end)
status: not a real open problem. This is a deliberately simple, deliberately FALSE toy claim (n=7 is a trivial counterexample) used exclusively to exercise and test the search -> candidate -> certificate -> independent verification pipeline end to end at negligible computational cost.
known_bounds: trivial: the first counterexample in any interval containing a positive multiple of 7 is that multiple
certificate_type: counterexample: witness n; bounded_result: search interval [begin, end) (only meaningful for intervals with no multiple of 7)
references: None. This is a synthetic test fixture, not a mathematical source.
